data.method: Each sector's headline is a Bower Digital composite: the equal-weighted average of the price returns of the sector funds listed for it (constituents and providers per row), equal weight at the start of each window, no rebalancing. The Select Sector SPDR fund is shown alongside as the single-fund reference. S&P 500 measured with SPY.

constituents.provider: State Street Global Advisors (Select Sector SPDR)
constituents.name: State Street Technology Select Sector SPDR ETF
constituents.index: Technology Select Sector Index

constituents.name: Vanguard Information Technology ETF
constituents.index: MSCI US Investable Market Information Technology 25/50 Index

constituents.name: Fidelity MSCI Information Technology Index ETF
constituents.index: MSCI USA IMI Information Technology 25/50 Index

composites.weighting: Equal weight: 3 funds, 33.33% each at the start of every window; no rebalancing within a window.
composites.returnBasis: Price return (split-adjusted daily closes; distributions not included) for every constituent.

data.returnBasis: Price return from daily closes (dividends not included). 1W/1M/3M/1Y compare the latest close with the last close on or before the same calendar date one week/month/three months/year earlier; YTD compares with the last close of the prior year.

classificationCheck.value: GOOGL, GOOG and META confirmed in XLC holdings and absent from XLK holdings; likewise in VOX and absent from VGT (Vanguard holdings as of 2026-09-30). FTEC and FCOM not checked: Fidelity's holdings need a session token.
